
   chainlock

  Seal  Lock a file so it opens only after a delay  (2 of 2)

  ┃ Algorithm
  ┃ Suggested for a 12h delay: 0x01 (argon2id-m128M-t5-p1).
  ┃ > 0x01  argon2id-m128M-t5-p1   128 MiB a step
  ┃   0x02  argon2id-m128M-t192-p1 128 MiB a step
  ┃   0x03  sha256-chain-k23       no memory
  ┃   0x04  sha256-chain-k28       no memory

    Save as
    > two files     notes.txt.lock and notes.txt.payload
      one archive   notes.txt.chainlock.tar
      raw files     no damage check

    Workers
    Steps computed at once. 0 or -1: one per core (4 here).
    > 0

    Key file
    Optional. Saves a key that opens the file at once, with no wait.
    Keep it somewhere other than the lock.
    >
